blurb: Wendella offers a variety of boat tours and cruises on the Chicago River and Lake Michigan. Guests can enjoy guided architecture tours, sunset cruises, wine and cheese cruises, and fireworks cruises. The company operates year-round with climate-controlled vessels and experienced guides.
